runs.final_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ln.dt,1,4)='1997' THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ln.dt,1,4)='1996' THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ln.dt,1,4)='1996' THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER' JOIN clnt ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1 WHERE clnt.gndr = 'M'
